exposure: exposure to infectious agents (proxied by early common infections and day-care attendance)
exposure to animals in early life (regular contact with pets)
cohort: The study included 617 children diagnosed with childhood acute lymphoblastic leukaemia (cases) and 1225 population controls, all aged >=1 year, from France.
finding: Inverse associations were observed between childhood ALL and early common infections, being non-first born, day-care attendance before age 1 year, breastfeeding, and regular contact with pets in infancy.
